title: death
summary: Benilla defines the death arc: corpse query, reclaim delay, resurrect request/response, spirit healer confirm/activate, reclaim corpse. MSUI implements CMSG_REPOP_REQUEST, CMSG_RECLAIM_CORPSE, CMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_ACTIVATE, CMSG_RESURRECT_RESPONSE (guid+accept byte) and handles SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST and SMSG_CORPSE_RECLAIM_DELAY.

openItems.text: MSG_CORPSE_QUERY: absent entirely (no empty-body request, no found/not-found response parse) - no corpse marker, and the unprompted bones-conversion not-found push is dropped
SMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_CONFIRM: absent (no handler for the gossip-driven spirit-healer confirm guid)
